slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Passages naming Egypt: Egypt is one of four African countries with a compulsory and universal civil registration system and scores 80-100% on the digitisation of civil registration and overall (October 2016 monitoring round). The only mention of a health information system is a continental remark that most countries do not link it to civil registration; nothing is stated about one in Egypt.
